svg.title: SURMOUNT-4: mean weight change continuing tirzepatide vs switching to placebo
svg.desc: After a 36-week open-label tirzepatide lead-in (mean −20.9%), participants randomized to continue lost a further 5.5% by week 88 (net −25.3% from week 0), while those switched to placebo regained 14.0% from week 36 (net −9.9% from week 0). Source: Aronne et al., JAMA 2024 abstract.
